words: An approved Plan is never edited
A posted ruling's steps are executed at once
A fix round is followed by a re-review slot item
No PR has a nothing to do state
The owner's call is labelled paused-owner at that moment
One ruling per PR; a further rejection goes to the owner
One verdict per review; a split Plan/Execution verdict counts as changes needed
A review never says a change makes a passage false
No piecemeal makes-false rounds; cut whole sections in one pass
Plan rejected: fix; second rejection: ruling; after a ruling: the owner
A plan-check failure goes back to the same worker
plan-check passes before the PR is marked ready
An approved Plan's commands run as written
A Plan row names the whole command of its Evidence line
CI evidence is a pointer to the head's run
The Execution review waits for full green CI on the reviewed head
After a merge of main the review covers only the resolution
Impossibility needs evidence first
Done-when appears only in the ticket body and changes only before a worker started
A Done-when must be X demonstrated by Y
A PR that closes several tickets needs a recorded ruling
An approved Plan is never judged again by the Plan-row rule
A review lists every finding in round one
Every escalation carries a How we got here section
An extra file found in review is removed and gets a .gitignore line
No line is added to any .md or .rst file
Docs that restate code are removed
A PR body never carries the harness's session URL footer
A relock and zip-only head needs no review
No scratch or temp file paths in Plans; the data lives in the PR or the ticket
A started PR gets nothing added
No attribution block; never assign or request review from the owner
Pins never move by an LLM
No bundled shims for weak engines
The cap is a hard ceiling; every running agent counts
A freed slot is filled in the same turn; skip blocked items
Never tell the owner nothing is running
The coordinator corrects a message that says the slot is idle
Re-run slots next before each dispatch
Only briefs pitboss prints; no hand-typed brief paths
One ticket, one PR, one task per ticket
Fold the newer ticket into the older
Order: running workers, PRs before tickets, priority, age
A blocker inherits the blocked item's rank
The task list is real state
The checklist lists every running agent
The check-in job is kept; a lapsed check-in is flagged
pitboss nox before every push is plenty; it is a maximum, not a target
Workers use their own worktree on the ticket's branch
Workers change files with the Edit tool only
A partial hand-back is refused unless Impossible: cmd -> output
Every hand-back and every disk clean is logged once
Pitboss's own PRs are never drafts
A runner-pressure hold covers pushes, merges and dispatches
A worker never changes a PR's draft state
Stuck GitHub runs are root-caused, not waited on
Another session's agents survive a restart and can duplicate a ticket
Never sit in a long wait; no polling
After a worker opens a PR, read the body footer and the text-lint status
A PR body edit keeps the Head: line and expand blocks in step with the head
Clean the disk without asking, harder over 90 percent
Never remove files under /dev
A merged worktree goes on merge
Never re-run CI to get rid of a flake; root-cause a failure from its log (a re-run that works around a GitHub problem is allowed)
Failed-check details are read through the API
A flake is never closed until addressed
A relock with green CI and pins-check OK merges with no review and ranks last
An unset secret fails
The sweep lists every org repo
The sweep and slots run from the newest pitboss
Everything the orchestrator creates is synced
A stale remote branch or scratch PR is flagged and closed
A re-run is refused only when it is to get rid of a flake; a re-run that works around a GitHub problem (a run stuck queued with no jobs) is allowed
Run pitboss, check its output, override a known bug disclosed
Do not report pitboss bugs to the coordinator; diagnose and file
The orchestrator owns pitboss and never waits for the owner on a pitboss decision
Never say I haven't checked
Every correction states its prevention
Rules go to memory and a pitboss ticket, never a skill or an md line
Never assume the owner acted
Ruling comments are standing-approved
Every question to the owner comes with a markdown artifact
Artifact and log reads of CI go through the new-environment thread
Quiesce: nothing starts until the owner lifts it
The owner stays private
The coordinator's instructions are an Opus ruling
A thread attaches a missing repo itself
Never resolve a human decision card
A PR body keeps its Execution section once the branch has code commits
A Plan row pointing to CI has its pointer in the Execution
